overview: The Strategic & Capital Planning subcommittee met to review the status of active and future school capital projects and to align their capital plan spreadsheet with city-side formats.

items.title: Status Updates on In-Progress Capital Projects
items.summary: Staff provided updates on active projects, reporting that district-wide security updates are slated for completion by mid-January, high school elevator repairs are underway, and school bike rack installations are nearly finished.

items.title: Network Closet Mini Splits Funding Review
items.summary: The subcommittee and staff reviewed confusing funding allocations for network closet mini split installations, noting that only the Roberts School has been completed so far.

items.title: Coordination with City Capital Planning and Formats
items.summary: Members discussed a request from the mayor's office to adapt their capital data into a specific Collins Center spreadsheet format and debated how to best integrate their long-term school facility assessments.

items.title: Future Capital Priorities and Playground Planning
items.summary: Staff shared updated cost projections for future capital needs, including a potential $150,000 design study for three school playgrounds.

items.title: Approval of Capital Plan for School Committee Agenda
items.summary: A motion to approve the capital plan and place it on the upcoming School Committee agenda was approved.
